items.headline: Over 400,000 Rally Across France in Mass Protests Over Soaring Living Costs
items.summary: More than 400,000 people marched across France on October 24 to protest rising living costs and public service funding, presenting a fresh political challenge to President Emmanuel Macron. The nationwide union-led demonstrations triggered heavy security deployments and ended in clashes that led to nearly 1,000 arrests.

items.headline: AI-Discovered Security Flaws in PHP Trigger Global Web Infrastructure Emergency
items.summary: Security agencies worldwide issued urgent advisories after artificial intelligence tools uncovered critical vulnerabilities in PHP, a programming language that powers roughly 70 percent of websites. The disclosure triggered millions of automated exploitation attempts, forcing governments and tech companies to rapidly issue emergency patches and temporarily take vulnerable systems offline.

items.headline: Golden State Valkyries Beat Atlanta Dream in Game 4 to Even WNBA Finals
items.summary: The Golden State Valkyries defeated the Atlanta Dream 67-62 on Saturday to level the WNBA Finals at 2-2. Gabby Williams scored 17 points and center Kiah Stokes set a WNBA Finals record for blocks to help Golden State push the best-of-seven championship series to Game 5.

items.headline: DC Studios' Horror Spinoff 'Clayface' Claims Top Spot at Weekend Box Office
items.summary: DC Studios' R-rated body-horror movie 'Clayface' opened at number one at the domestic box office, earning an estimated $24 million over its premiere weekend. Directed by James Watkins on a modest $44 million production budget, the villain origin story impressed audiences and earned a strong A- CinemaScore.
